senses.zh: phía tây nam; vùng tây nam
senses.en: the direction between south and west, or an area's southwestern part

senses.zh: thuộc tây nam; từ hướng tây nam
senses.en: in the southwest, or coming from that direction

senses.zh: về phía tây nam; ở phía tây nam
senses.en: towards or in the direction between south and west

ex.en: Our village lies southwest of the nearest town.
The southwest of the country attracts visitors because of its mild climate and varied coastal landscapes.

col: in the southwest｜ở phía tây nam
southwest of｜về phía tây nam của
head southwest｜đi về hướng tây nam
tip: Tiếng Anh Anh cũng thường viết là south-west.

senses.zh: hằng tuần; mỗi tuần một lần
senses.en: Happening once a week or relating to one week
Once every week
A newspaper or magazine published once a week

ex.en: Our weekly shopping trip usually ends at the bakery.
Weekly exercise classes at community centres can help older residents stay active and build social connections.

col: a weekly meeting｜cuộc họp hằng tuần
tip: Vừa là tính từ vừa là trạng từ: a weekly meeting; meet weekly.

senses.en: To cause a person, animal, or other organism to die
To cause something to stop or fail

ex.en: This soap helps kill germs on your hands.
Excessive use of pesticides can kill beneficial insects and disrupt the natural balance of agricultural ecosystems.

col: kill off｜diệt sạch; xóa bỏ hoàn toàn
tip: kill nhấn mạnh việc gây ra cái chết; die là tự chết và không có tân ngữ.

senses.en: hanging fabric used to cover a window or divide space
a large hanging cloth that hides or reveals a stage

ex.en: She pulled the curtain aside to watch the rain.
Installing a thick curtain over each window can reduce heat loss and improve comfort in older homes.

tip: draw the curtains có thể là kéo ra hoặc kéo lại, tùy ngữ cảnh.

senses.en: to move something towards you or along by holding it
an act of pulling or a force drawing something closer

senses.zh: bị căng cơ; kéo giãn cơ
senses.en: to injure a muscle by stretching it too much

ex.en: Please pull the door gently instead of pushing it.
Horses once pulled heavy loads through cities, but motor vehicles eventually replaced them in most transport roles.

col: pull a door open｜kéo cửa mở ra
tip: pull là kéo về phía mình; push là đẩy ra xa.

senses.en: Vehicles moving along roads in a particular area

senses.zh: lưu lượng truy cập; lưu lượng mạng
senses.en: The amount of data or messages passing through a system

ex.en: Heavy traffic made us late for dinner again.
Investing in reliable public transport can reduce traffic congestion and improve urban air quality.

col: internet traffic｜lưu lượng truy cập internet
tip: Chỉ giao thông hay dòng xe thì không đếm được, không nói a traffic.

senses.en: In the direction of someone or something
In relation to someone or something, especially attitudes or behaviour
Helping to achieve or pay for something

ex.en: The puppy ran toward me with a muddy ball.
Investment in public transport is an important step toward reducing traffic congestion and improving urban air quality.

col: a step toward｜một bước tiến tới
go toward the cost｜dùng để chi trả
tip: toward và towards cùng nghĩa; toward phổ biến hơn trong tiếng Anh Mỹ.

senses.en: A large round object that travels around a star.

ex.en: We watched a bright planet through the telescope tonight.
Scientists study distant planets to understand whether conditions suitable for life exist beyond Earth.

col: a distant planet｜một hành tinh xa xôi
orbit a planet｜quay quanh hành tinh
protect the planet｜bảo vệ hành tinh
tip: planet là hành tinh, star là ngôi sao; the planet thường chỉ Trái Đất.

senses.zh: truyền thống; có từ lâu đời
senses.en: Following customs or methods passed down over a long time.

ex.en: We cooked a traditional meal for the family gathering.
Traditional farming methods can preserve local knowledge, although some require adaptation to cope with climate change.

col: traditional crafts｜nghề thủ công truyền thống
tip: traditional nhấn mạnh sự truyền lại lâu đời, không nhất thiết là lạc hậu.

senses.en: programs that tell a computer how to perform tasks

ex.en: This software helps me edit photos on my laptop.
Schools need reliable software and adequate teacher training to make effective use of digital learning tools.

col: open-source software｜phần mềm mã nguồn mở
tip: Không đếm được: nói some software, không nói a software.

senses.en: Used with I or we to offer or suggest something.
Used with I or we to express future intentions formally.
Used in formal rules to state a requirement.

ex.en: Shall we take a short walk after dinner?
Under the proposed regulations, employers shall provide appropriate safety equipment for all workers handling hazardous materials.

col: shall we｜chúng ta có nên ... không
tip: Là động từ khuyết thiếu, theo sau là động từ nguyên mẫu; Shall we thường dùng để đề nghị.

senses.en: A container made from woven strips, wire, or similar materials

senses.zh: rổ bóng rổ; điểm ghi được
senses.en: The hoop and net in basketball, or a score through it

ex.en: I carried a basket of fresh apples into the kitchen.
Providing reusable shopping baskets can encourage customers to reduce their reliance on disposable plastic bags.

col: a basket of fruit｜một giỏ trái cây
tip: a basket of apples là một giỏ táo; số lượng giỏ dùng baskets.

senses.en: someone who steals another person's belongings

ex.en: The thief took my bicycle while I was shopping.
Secure bicycle parking can make it harder for a thief to steal from commuters.

col: a bicycle thief｜kẻ trộm xe đạp
tip: Số nhiều là thieves; robber thường liên quan đến bạo lực hoặc đe dọa.

senses.en: The system of connected pages accessed through the internet.
A structure of fine threads a spider makes to catch insects.

senses.zh: mạng lưới phức tạp; mối quan hệ chằng chịt
senses.en: A complicated network of connected things or relationships.

ex.en: I found a simple soup recipe on the web.
Although the web provides convenient access to information, students must learn to evaluate the reliability of online sources.

col: a web of relationships｜mạng lưới quan hệ chằng chịt
tip: “Trên mạng” thường nói on the web; web không hoàn toàn đồng nghĩa với internet.

senses.en: Someone paid to work for a person or organisation.

ex.en: A new employee showed me around the bakery.
Employers should provide every employee with appropriate training to maintain a safe and productive workplace.

col: full-time employee｜nhân viên toàn thời gian
employee turnover｜tỷ lệ nghỉ việc của nhân viên
tip: employee là người làm thuê, employer là người thuê lao động.

senses.zh: đường sắt; hệ thống đường sắt
senses.en: Tracks and services used by trains to transport people or goods.

ex.en: Our house overlooks the railway near the old bridge.
Investment in railway networks can reduce road congestion while improving access to employment in neighbouring cities.

col: a railway network｜mạng lưới đường sắt
railway infrastructure｜cơ sở hạ tầng đường sắt
tip: railway thường dùng trong tiếng Anh Anh; tiếng Anh Mỹ thường dùng railroad.

senses.zh: sự mô tả; bản miêu tả
senses.en: an account explaining what someone or something is like

ex.en: Your description helped me find the little bakery.
A clear description of research methods allows other scientists to evaluate the reliability of a study.

col: a detailed description｜mô tả chi tiết
give a description of｜mô tả về
a job description｜bản mô tả công việc
an accurate description｜mô tả chính xác
tip: Mô tả về thứ gì thì dùng a description of, không dùng about.

senses.en: A deep container used for cooking food.
A container used for plants, storage, or serving drinks.
To put a plant into a container with soil.

ex.en: The soup is bubbling gently in a large pot.
Growing vegetables in pots allows residents with limited outdoor space to produce some of their own food.

col: a pot of soup｜một nồi súp
a pot of tea｜một ấm trà
tip: Nồi, chậu, hũ đều có thể gọi là pot; chảo rán thường dùng pan.

senses.en: A unit of distance equal to one thousand metres.

ex.en: The nearest bus stop is about a kilometre away.
Building safe cycle lanes within a kilometre of schools could encourage more children to cycle daily.

col: a kilometre away｜cách một cây số
tip: Anh Anh viết kilometre, Anh Mỹ viết kilometer.

senses.en: A man whose job is delivering milk to homes.

ex.en: The milkman left two glass bottles outside our door.
Regular deliveries by a local milkman can encourage households to reuse glass bottles rather than discard plastic containers.

col: local milkman｜người giao sữa trong vùng
the milkman's round｜lộ trình giao sữa
tip: Số nhiều là milkmen; không chỉ người vắt sữa, người vắt sữa là milker.

senses.en: A journey through the air, especially in an aircraft.
The act or ability of moving through the air.
A continuous set of stairs between floors or landings.

ex.en: Our flight leaves early, so we should pack tonight.
Reducing the number of short domestic flights could lower emissions where reliable rail alternatives already exist.

col: book a flight｜đặt vé máy bay
a flight of stairs｜một dãy cầu thang
tip: a flight of stairs là một đoạn cầu thang giữa hai tầng hoặc hai chiếu nghỉ.

senses.en: something that makes an event or situation happen
make something happen, especially something unpleasant
an aim or principle that people support and work towards

ex.en: The plumber found the cause of the leak.
Heavy traffic is a major cause of air pollution in many rapidly growing urban areas.

col: a good cause｜một sự nghiệp ý nghĩa
tip: Danh từ thường đi với of; động từ có thể dùng cause sb to do sth.

senses.en: information and understanding gained through learning or experience
awareness of a particular fact or situation

ex.en: My grandfather shared his knowledge of birds with me.
Schools should help students apply their knowledge to practical problems rather than simply memorise facts.

col: without someone's knowledge｜mà ai đó không hay biết
tip: Thường không đếm được; có thể nói a good knowledge of một lĩnh vực.

senses.en: the arrangement of things or a controlled, peaceful situation

senses.zh: đặt hàng; gọi món; ra lệnh
senses.en: to request goods or food, or tell someone what to do
a request for goods or an instruction that must be obeyed

ex.en: Please put these photos in the correct order.
Online shoppers can now order fresh produce directly from local farms, supporting regional economies.

col: in alphabetical order｜theo thứ tự bảng chữ cái
order someone to do something｜ra lệnh cho ai làm gì
tip: in order là theo thứ tự; in order to theo sau là động từ, nghĩa là “để”.

senses.en: The solid surface of the earth.
Reasons or evidence supporting a belief, decision, or action.
To prevent an aircraft from flying.

ex.en: We spread a blanket on the ground beneath a tree.
Planting trees helps the ground retain moisture and reduces the risk of soil erosion.

col: grounds for complaint｜lý do để khiếu nại
ground a plane｜cấm máy bay cất cánh
tip: Khi nghĩa là “lý do” thường dùng số nhiều grounds; ground cũng là quá khứ của grind.

senses.en: A large road vehicle used for carrying goods.

ex.en: A lorry delivered fresh vegetables to the shop.
Restricting lorry deliveries during peak hours could reduce congestion and improve road safety in city centres.

col: load a lorry｜chất hàng lên xe tải
tip: lorry chủ yếu dùng trong tiếng Anh Anh; tiếng Anh Mỹ thường dùng truck.

senses.en: a European country occupying most of the island of Ireland
an island west of Great Britain

ex.en: We explored the west coast of Ireland by bicycle.
Ireland attracts international students through its English-speaking universities and opportunities to experience a different culture.

col: the Republic of Ireland｜Cộng hòa Ai-len
tip: Có thể chỉ quốc gia hoặc cả hòn đảo; Bắc Ireland thuộc Vương quốc Anh, không thuộc quốc gia này.

senses.en: To move or act quickly, or make someone do so.

senses.zh: sự vội vàng; sự gấp gáp
senses.en: A need to act quickly because time is limited.

ex.en: We hurried home before the rain began to fall.
When teachers hurry through difficult material, students may struggle to develop a clear understanding of key concepts.

col: hurry through something｜làm cho xong qua loa
tip: hurry up dùng để thúc giục; in a hurry nghĩa là đang vội.

senses.en: The hard covering at the end of a finger or toe.
A thin pointed metal piece used to fasten materials together.
To attach something using nails.

ex.en: I cut my nails before my piano lesson.
Teaching children to keep their nails clean can help establish healthy personal hygiene habits early.

tip: Vừa là móng tay vừa là cái đinh; khi là động từ nghĩa là đóng bằng đinh.

senses.en: The organ that digests food, or the surrounding body area
To accept something unpleasant without feeling upset or disgusted

ex.en: My stomach started rumbling while I was cooking dinner.
Eating regular meals may help prevent stomach discomfort and support healthy eating habits among students.

col: stomach ache｜đau bụng; đau dạ dày
tip: Với nghĩa “chịu đựng”, thường dùng trong cấu trúc can't stomach.

senses.en: Food with a pastry base or covering and a filling.

ex.en: We shared a warm apple pie after dinner.
Traditional dishes, such as fruit pie, can help preserve regional food culture across generations.

col: a slice of pie｜một miếng bánh pie
tip: pie là bánh nướng có nhân; “biểu đồ tròn” phải nói pie chart.

senses.en: a type, arrangement, or shape of something
a document with spaces for providing requested information

senses.zh: hình thành; tạo thành; lập nên
senses.en: to develop, create, or combine into something

ex.en: The clouds took the form of a giant rabbit.
Online learning has become a popular form of education because it offers flexibility for working adults.

col: fill in a form｜điền vào mẫu đơn
form a habit｜hình thành thói quen
tip: fill in a form là cách nói Anh Anh; tiếng Anh Mỹ thường dùng fill out a form.

senses.en: The act of focusing your mind on someone or something.

senses.zh: sự chăm sóc; sự xử lý; sự quan tâm
senses.en: Care or action given to someone or something that needs it.

ex.en: Please pay attention while I explain the game.
Schools should give greater attention to students' emotional wellbeing alongside their academic progress.

col: attract attention｜thu hút sự chú ý
attention span｜khoảng thời gian có thể tập trung
tip: Sau pay attention to là danh từ hoặc danh động từ, vì to là giới từ.

senses.en: the way someone's hair is cut or arranged

ex.en: Your new hairstyle really suits your round glasses.
In some workplaces, strict rules about hairstyles can limit employees' freedom to express their identity.

col: a fashionable hairstyle｜kiểu tóc thời thượng
tip: Danh từ đếm được, chỉ toàn bộ kiểu tóc được cắt hoặc tạo kiểu.

senses.en: A book containing exercises for learners to complete
A computer file containing one or more spreadsheets

ex.en: I left my workbook in my school bag.
A well-designed workbook allows students to practise new skills independently and monitor their progress.

col: complete a workbook｜làm xong sách bài tập
workbook exercises｜bài tập trong sách bài tập
a grammar workbook｜sách bài tập ngữ pháp
tip: workbook thiên về luyện tập; textbook thiên về trình bày kiến thức.

senses.en: a group of things sharing particular features
to enter words using a keyboard

ex.en: What type of bread would you like today?
Different types of public transport are needed to serve both urban and rural communities.

col: type a message｜gõ một tin nhắn
tip: type of đi với danh từ; nhiều loại thì dùng types of.

senses.en: a word that describes a person, thing, or state

ex.en: Our teacher asked us to find adjectives describing weather.
In academic writing, precise adjectives help readers understand complex ideas without relying on lengthy explanations.

col: a descriptive adjective｜tính từ miêu tả
a comparative adjective｜tính từ so sánh
tip: Tính từ thường đứng trước danh từ hoặc sau động từ nối, như a cold day.

senses.en: The natural outer covering of a person's or animal's body.
The thin outer layer of certain fruits and vegetables.
Remove the skin from an animal, fruit or vegetable.

ex.en: My skin feels dry after swimming in the pool.
Protecting skin from excessive sunlight can reduce the risk of serious health problems later in life.

tip: Da người thường không đếm được; tấm da thú thì đếm được.

senses.en: To choose what to do after considering the possibilities.
To determine the result of something.

ex.en: We decided to walk home after the film.
Governments must decide how to distribute limited resources between healthcare, education and public transport.

col: decide to do something｜quyết định làm việc gì
decide on｜chọn ra; quyết định chọn
decide the outcome｜quyết định kết quả
tip: Dùng decide to do, không dùng decide doing.

senses.en: causing physical pain or hurting
causing sadness, distress, or embarrassment

ex.en: My ankle is still painful when I climb stairs.
For many workers, losing a secure job is a painful experience that affects both confidence and financial stability.

col: a painful injury｜một vết thương đau đớn
a painful experience｜một trải nghiệm đau khổ
painful memories｜những ký ức đau buồn
painful to touch｜sờ vào thấy đau
tip: painful có thể chỉ đau thể xác, cũng có thể chỉ nỗi đau tinh thần hoặc sự khó xử.

senses.en: The one or ones belonging to them

ex.en: Our garden is small, but theirs has several trees.
Some families own their homes, while others rent theirs because property prices remain beyond their reach.

col: a friend of theirs｜một người bạn của họ
ours and theirs｜của chúng tôi và của họ
tip: theirs dùng độc lập, không theo sau bởi danh từ và không có dấu nháy đơn.

senses.en: An outdoor area where children play, often with special equipment.

ex.en: The children raced to the playground after lunch.
Every neighbourhood should provide a safe playground where children can exercise and develop social skills.

tip: Chủ yếu chỉ nơi trẻ em vui chơi, không dùng cho sân vận động chuyên nghiệp.

senses.en: Making or having a strong sound that is easily heard.
With a strong sound that is easily heard.

ex.en: A loud crash woke everyone in the house.
Frequent exposure to loud music can damage hearing, particularly among young people who use headphones.

col: loud and clear｜rõ ràng và to
tip: read out loud là đọc thành tiếng; loudly cũng có nghĩa là một cách ầm ĩ.

senses.en: To speak or call out in a very loud voice.
A loud call or cry made with the voice.

ex.en: We shouted across the river, but nobody heard us.
In noisy classrooms, teachers may need to shout, which can strain their voices over time.

col: shout for help｜hét lên kêu cứu
shout to someone｜gọi to với ai
a shout of joy｜tiếng reo vui
tip: shout at thường hàm ý giận dữ; shout to nhằm cho người ở xa nghe thấy.

senses.en: At the side of someone or something.

ex.en: Please leave your wet boots beside the door.
Creating walking paths beside urban rivers can encourage physical activity and improve residents' access to nature.

col: beside the point｜lạc đề; không liên quan
tip: beside nghĩa là “bên cạnh”; besides nghĩa là “ngoài ra; ngoài ... ra”.

senses.en: The joint where your leg bends in the middle.

ex.en: She bent her knee gently before starting the exercise.
Regular low-impact exercise can strengthen the muscles around the knee and help maintain mobility in older adults.

tip: Chữ k đầu từ không đọc; số nhiều knees đọc là /niːz/.

senses.en: to fasten something using string, rope, or a knot
a long narrow piece of cloth worn around the collar
a connection between people, groups, or places

ex.en: Please tie your shoelaces before you run outside.
Strong ties between schools and local employers can help young people make a smoother transition into work.

col: family ties｜mối quan hệ gia đình
strengthen ties｜củng cố mối quan hệ
tip: Hiện tại phân từ của tie là tying; nghĩa quan hệ thường dùng số nhiều ties.

senses.en: With someone or something as part of a larger group.

ex.en: Everyone came to the picnic, including our new neighbours.
Cities should provide accessible public spaces for all residents, including older people and those with limited mobility.

col: including delivery｜đã gồm phí giao hàng
tip: including theo sau là danh từ hoặc đại từ; included thường đặt sau.

senses.zh: chính tả; khả năng viết đúng chữ
senses.en: forming words correctly using their written characters
the particular way a word is written

ex.en: My sister checks my spelling before I send emails.
Although digital tools can correct spelling, students still need to develop accurate writing skills.

col: check your spelling｜kiểm tra chính tả
tip: Khi chỉ khả năng viết chính tả thì thường không đếm được; chỉ cách viết cụ thể thì đếm được.

senses.en: relating to Korea, its people, or its language
the language spoken in North and South Korea
a person from North or South Korea

ex.en: Our neighbour showed us how to make Korean dumplings.
Korean cinema has attracted international audiences, encouraging wider interest in the country's language and cultural traditions.

tip: Korean có thể chỉ cả hai nước trên bán đảo Triều Tiên, nghĩa cụ thể tùy ngữ cảnh.

senses.zh: thuộc Ấn Độ; thuộc người Ấn
senses.en: relating to India or its people
a person from India

ex.en: We cooked an Indian curry for dinner last night.
Indian cities face growing pressure to expand public transport as urban populations continue to increase.

tip: Viết hoa chữ cái đầu; khi nói về thổ dân châu Mỹ nên dùng tên mà họ tự gọi.

senses.zh: trí óc; tâm trí; tư duy
senses.en: The part of you that thinks, feels, and remembers.
To feel annoyed or uncomfortable about something.

senses.zh: chú ý; cẩn thận; trông nom
senses.en: To pay attention to something or take care of someone.

ex.en: Would you mind closing the window before you leave?
Regular physical activity can benefit both the body and the mind by reducing stress and improving concentration.

col: mind doing something｜phiền làm việc gì
peace of mind｜sự thanh thản trong lòng
tip: Để nói phiền khi làm gì dùng mind doing, không dùng mind to do.

senses.en: Extremely small in size or amount.

ex.en: A tiny frog jumped out of the flower pot.
Even tiny changes in daily habits can reduce household energy consumption over time.

col: a tiny amount｜một lượng rất nhỏ
a tiny fraction｜một phần rất nhỏ
a tiny village｜một ngôi làng nhỏ xíu
tip: Mạnh hơn small, nhấn mạnh sự nhỏ đến đáng ngạc nhiên.

senses.en: A bag carried on the back using two shoulder straps.

senses.zh: đi du lịch bụi; du lịch ba lô
senses.en: To travel carrying your belongings in a backpack.

ex.en: I packed my lunch and jacket in my backpack.
Young adults often backpack through rural regions, supporting small businesses and learning about local traditions.

col: pack a backpack｜sắp xếp ba lô
a hiking backpack｜ba lô đi bộ đường dài
tip: Chỉ ba lô đeo hai vai; tiếng Anh Anh cũng thường dùng rucksack.

senses.zh: bài kiểm tra ngắn; trò đố kiến thức
senses.en: A short test or game involving questions.
To test someone's knowledge or ask them detailed questions.

ex.en: We played a music quiz after dinner yesterday.
A short quiz at the beginning of each lesson can help teachers identify gaps in students' understanding.

col: take a quiz｜làm một bài kiểm tra ngắn
general knowledge quiz｜đố vui kiến thức chung
tip: Số nhiều là quizzes; quá khứ là quizzed.

senses.en: a film or programme made using animated drawings or images
a humorous drawing, often commenting on society or politics

ex.en: We watched a funny cartoon about a dancing penguin.
Political cartoons can communicate complex social criticism through simple images that appeal to a wide audience.

col: political cartoon｜tranh biếm họa chính trị
tip: cartoon có thể là phim hoạt hình hoặc tranh vui một khung; truyện tranh thường dùng comic.

senses.zh: nghịch ngợm; hư; không vâng lời
senses.en: Behaving badly, especially by disobeying adults

ex.en: The naughty puppy dragged my slippers into the garden.
Children described as naughty may benefit more from patient guidance than from repeated punishment.

tip: Thường dùng cho trẻ em hoặc thú cưng, thường không chỉ lỗi nghiêm trọng.

senses.en: A machine carrying people or goods between floors.

ex.en: We took the elevator because our bags were heavy.
Installing elevators in older apartment buildings can significantly improve accessibility for elderly residents and people with disabilities.

col: a passenger elevator｜thang máy chở khách
tip: Tiếng Anh Mỹ thường dùng elevator; tiếng Anh Anh thường dùng lift.

senses.en: coming last in a series or process
settled and not open to further change or discussion

senses.zh: trận chung kết; kỳ thi cuối kỳ
senses.en: a competition's last match, or an examination ending a course

ex.en: We packed the final box and locked the door.
The final stage of the research involved comparing energy consumption across several types of housing.

tip: finally là trạng từ; final làm danh từ có thể là trận chung kết hoặc kỳ thi cuối kỳ.

senses.en: A large round fruit with thick skin and sweet, juicy flesh.

ex.en: She sliced a ripe melon for our picnic.
Farmers growing melons in dry regions often use efficient irrigation systems to reduce water consumption.

col: a slice of melon｜một miếng dưa
tip: melon chỉ chung các loại dưa; watermelon chuyên chỉ dưa hấu.

senses.zh: nổi tiếng; được nhiều người biết
senses.en: known or recognised by many people

ex.en: We visited a well-known castle during our summer holiday.
Well-known tourist destinations often face overcrowding, which can damage historic sites and reduce residents' quality of life.

col: well-known fact｜sự thật ai cũng biết
tip: Đứng trước danh từ thường có gạch nối; đứng sau động từ nối thường viết well known.

senses.zh: đầu bếp chuyên nghiệp; bếp trưởng
senses.en: A trained cook working in a restaurant or hotel.

ex.en: The chef added fresh herbs to the steaming soup.
A skilled chef can design nutritious school meals that appeal to children while staying within a limited budget.

col: train as a chef｜được đào tạo thành đầu bếp
tip: ch trong chef đọc là /ʃ/; thường chỉ đầu bếp chuyên nghiệp ở nhà hàng hoặc khách sạn.

senses.en: in fact, often surprisingly or contrary to what was expected

ex.en: I thought this soup was spicy, but it is actually sweet.
Although online courses seem convenient, some students actually learn more effectively through face-to-face interaction.

col: actually mean｜thực sự có nghĩa là
tip: actually nghĩa là “thực ra”, không có nghĩa là “hiện nay”.

senses.en: a piece of absorbent cloth used for drying things
to dry someone or something with a towel

ex.en: He wrapped a warm towel around his wet shoulders.
Hotels can reduce water consumption by encouraging guests to reuse their towels during their stay.

col: paper towel｜khăn giấy; giấy lau tay
tip: Đếm được; paper towel là giấy thấm hút, không phải khăn vải.

senses.en: One of the five separate parts at the foot's end
The part of a shoe or sock covering the toes

ex.en: There is a little sand stuck between my toes.
Wearing shoes that restrict toe movement may affect balance and contribute to foot problems over time.

col: from head to toe｜từ đầu đến chân
tip: Ngón tay là finger, ngón chân là toe; ngón chân cái là big toe.

senses.zh: thuộc con người; thuộc nhân loại
senses.en: Relating to people rather than animals or machines.
A person, as distinct from an animal or machine.

ex.en: This robot can recognise a familiar human voice.
Human activity has significantly altered natural habitats, making wildlife conservation an urgent priority for governments.

col: human activity｜hoạt động của con người
tip: human nghĩa là “thuộc con người”; humane nghĩa là “nhân đạo”.

senses.en: a situation without war, fighting, or serious disagreement

senses.zh: sự yên bình; sự thanh thản
senses.en: a state of quietness or freedom from worry

ex.en: I enjoy the peace of this garden before breakfast.
Lasting peace depends on cooperation between communities and fair access to essential resources.

tip: Thường không đếm được; peace of mind nghĩa là sự yên tâm.

senses.en: A moving ridge of water or a travelling energy disturbance.
To move a hand or object repeatedly as a signal.
A sudden increase or spread of something.

ex.en: A huge wave washed over our little sandcastle.
Coastal wetlands can absorb wave energy, helping to protect nearby settlements from erosion and storm damage.

col: wave goodbye｜vẫy tay chào tạm biệt
wave at someone｜vẫy tay chào ai
a wave of protests｜một làn sóng biểu tình
tip: Vẫy tay chào ai thì dùng wave at hoặc wave to someone.

senses.en: Strike someone or something with force.

senses.zh: tác động nặng nề; giáng đòn
senses.en: Affect someone or something badly, often suddenly.

senses.zh: thành công lớn; sản phẩm ăn khách
senses.en: Someone or something that becomes very popular or successful.

ex.en: The ball hit the fence and bounced towards me.
Rising energy prices have hit small businesses particularly hard, forcing many owners to reduce their operating hours.

col: be hit hard｜bị ảnh hưởng nặng nề
a big hit｜một thành công lớn
hit a target｜bắn trúng mục tiêu
tip: Quá khứ và quá khứ phân từ vẫn là hit; hiện tại phân từ là hitting.

senses.en: To move someone or something to a higher position.
A machine carrying people or goods between floors.
A ride in someone else's vehicle.

ex.en: Can you help me lift this box onto the shelf?
Installing lifts in older public buildings can improve access for wheelchair users and people with limited mobility.

col: give someone a lift｜cho ai đi nhờ xe
lift a ban｜dỡ bỏ lệnh cấm
tip: Thang máy dùng lift trong tiếng Anh Anh và elevator trong tiếng Anh Mỹ.

senses.en: An arrangement to meet someone at a particular time.
The act of choosing someone for a job or position.

ex.en: I have a dental appointment early tomorrow morning.
Flexible working hours allow employees to attend medical appointments without taking an entire day off.

col: by appointment only｜chỉ tiếp theo lịch hẹn
appointment of a director｜bổ nhiệm giám đốc
tip: Hẹn gặp ai dùng appointment with; bổ nhiệm ai dùng appointment of.

senses.en: A British coin or unit worth one hundredth of a pound.
An American coin worth one hundredth of a dollar.

ex.en: I found a penny underneath the sofa this morning.
For families on low incomes, every penny saved on energy bills can make a difference.

tip: Số tiền ở Anh dùng pence; nhiều đồng xu cụ thể dùng pennies.

senses.en: A sweet spread made by cooking fruit with sugar.
A situation where movement stops because things are packed together.
To become stuck, or force something into a tight space.

ex.en: I spread strawberry jam on my toast this morning.
Frequent traffic jams increase air pollution and make daily journeys more stressful for urban residents.

col: jam something into｜nhét thứ gì vào
tip: Mứt thường không đếm được; một vụ kẹt xe là a traffic jam.

senses.en: usually, or in most situations
in the usual, expected, or healthy way

ex.en: I normally walk to work unless it rains heavily.
Students normally benefit from regular feedback, especially when teachers provide clear guidance on improving their work.

tip: Có thể chỉ tần suất (thường thì) hoặc trạng thái (một cách bình thường).

senses.en: the main unit of money used in the United Kingdom
a unit of weight equal to about 454 grams

senses.zh: đập liên hồi; đập thình thịch
senses.en: to hit repeatedly with force or beat strongly

ex.en: I paid one pound for this bag of apples.
A weaker pound can attract international tourists, but it also raises the cost of imported goods.

col: a pound of butter｜một pao bơ
pound on the door｜đập mạnh vào cửa
tip: Cả đồng bảng Anh và đơn vị pao đều là pound; số nhiều thường thêm s.

senses.en: Something you want to accomplish through effort.
A score made by sending a ball into a goal.
A frame or area players aim to send a ball into.

ex.en: My goal is to swim across the pool unaided.
Setting realistic goals can help university students manage their time and maintain motivation during demanding courses.

col: achieve a goal｜đạt được mục tiêu
a long-term goal｜mục tiêu dài hạn
tip: Mục tiêu dùng set hoặc achieve; ghi bàn dùng score a goal.

senses.en: To become impossible to see or find.

senses.zh: không còn tồn tại; tuyệt chủng
senses.en: To stop existing.

ex.en: We watched the boat disappear into the thick fog.
Many traditional crafts may disappear unless governments support skilled workers and encourage younger generations to learn them.

col: disappear from view｜khuất khỏi tầm nhìn
disappear without a trace｜biến mất không dấu vết
tip: Thường là nội động từ, không nói be disappeared.

senses.en: to press something or move it away by applying force
to strongly encourage or force someone to act

senses.zh: sự đẩy; nỗ lực mạnh mẽ
senses.en: an act of pushing or a determined effort

ex.en: Could you push the trolley while I carry these bags?
Schools should encourage academic progress without pushing students to compete constantly with their classmates.

col: push someone to do something｜thúc giục ai làm việc gì
push for reform｜đấu tranh đòi cải cách
tip: push là đẩy, pull là kéo; push for nghĩa là đòi hỏi hoặc vận động cho điều gì.

senses.en: A building where people watch plays and other live performances.
The activity or art of writing, producing, and performing plays.
A specially equipped room in a hospital where operations happen.

ex.en: We arrived at the theatre just before the play started.
Public funding for theatre can make live performances accessible to audiences who cannot afford expensive tickets.

col: go to the theatre｜đi xem kịch
tip: Anh Anh viết theatre, Anh Mỹ thường viết theater; rạp chiếu phim ở Anh dùng cinema.

senses.en: Someone who studies the natural world through research and experiments

ex.en: The scientist examined a drop of water under the microscope.
Scientists are developing more efficient batteries to support the transition from fossil fuels to renewable energy.

col: research scientist｜nhà nghiên cứu khoa học
leading scientist｜nhà khoa học hàng đầu
environmental scientist｜nhà khoa học môi trường
tip: scientist chỉ người, science là khoa học, scientific là tính từ.

senses.en: a country in northern Europe, with Copenhagen as its capital

ex.en: My cousin moved to Denmark to study architecture.
Denmark offers useful examples of how cycling infrastructure can support healthier and more sustainable urban transport.

col: live in Denmark｜sống ở Đan Mạch
the capital of Denmark｜thủ đô của Đan Mạch
tip: Trước tên nước thường không dùng the; người Đan Mạch là Dane.

senses.en: Coming immediately after seventh in order
One of eight equal parts of something

ex.en: Our apartment is on the eighth floor of this building.
The survey ranked public transport eighth among the factors influencing where young professionals choose to live.

col: one eighth of｜một phần tám của
tip: Trước số thứ tự thường có the; th trong eighth đọc là /θ/.

senses.en: By good fortune, often avoiding an unpleasant result.

ex.en: My bag fell open, but luckily nothing dropped out.
The storm damaged several classrooms, but luckily the school had already moved its students to a safer building.

col: luckily for us｜may cho chúng tôi
luckily no one was hurt｜may mà không ai bị thương
tip: Thường bổ nghĩa cho cả câu; đứng đầu câu thường có dấu phẩy theo sau.

senses.en: beautiful or attractive in a pleasing way
very pleasant, enjoyable, or kind

ex.en: There are lovely yellow flowers beside the kitchen window.
Preserving lovely coastal landscapes can attract visitors while giving local residents valuable spaces for outdoor recreation.

col: a lovely view｜một khung cảnh đẹp
have a lovely time｜có khoảng thời gian vui vẻ
a lovely person｜một người dễ mến
tip: Dù tận cùng bằng -ly, đây là tính từ; rất phổ biến trong khẩu ngữ tiếng Anh Anh.

senses.en: a door or passage used to leave a place
to leave a place or close a computer program

ex.en: We found the exit at the back of the cinema.
Public buildings must have clearly visible emergency exits so that occupants can leave safely during an evacuation.

col: fire exit｜cửa thoát khi có cháy
exit a program｜thoát khỏi chương trình
tip: Danh từ là “lối ra”, động từ là “rời đi”; đừng nhầm với exist.

senses.en: A competition to see who finishes a course fastest.
A social grouping based on perceived shared ancestry and physical characteristics.
To compete in speed or move very quickly.

ex.en: We watched the boat race from the bridge.
Schools should ensure that all children receive equal educational opportunities, regardless of their race or family income.

col: win a race｜thắng một cuộc đua
a relay race｜cuộc chạy tiếp sức
regardless of race｜bất kể chủng tộc
race against time｜chạy đua với thời gian
tip: race có thể là cuộc đua hoặc chủng tộc; đừng nhầm với dân tộc.

senses.en: despite the fact that

ex.en: Although it was raining, we still walked home.
Although renewable energy requires substantial initial investment, it can lower electricity costs in the long term.

col: although it is true that｜mặc dù đúng là
although not always｜mặc dù không phải lúc nào cũng vậy
tip: Dẫn mệnh đề nhượng bộ; trong cùng một câu thường không dùng thêm but ở mệnh đề chính.

senses.en: to prevent something from happening or refrain from doing something
to stay away from someone or something

ex.en: We left early to avoid the morning traffic.
Cities should improve public transport to avoid further increases in traffic congestion and air pollution.

col: avoid doing something｜tránh làm việc gì
tip: Theo sau là danh từ hoặc danh động từ: avoid doing, không dùng to do.

senses.en: An opening or place through which people enter.
The act of entering or the right to join.

ex.en: I'll meet you at the entrance after lunch.
Universities should ensure that entrance requirements recognise different educational backgrounds while maintaining appropriate academic standards.

col: an entrance exam｜kỳ thi đầu vào
tip: Lối vào của một nơi dùng entrance to, không dùng entrance of.

senses.en: nervous or uncomfortable when meeting or speaking to people
to move away suddenly in fear, especially of a horse

ex.en: Lina felt shy when she joined the new club.
Small group discussions can help shy students gain confidence before speaking in front of the whole class.

tip: shy away from theo sau là danh từ hoặc danh động từ, nghĩa là né tránh.

senses.en: a yellow citrus fruit with sour juice
having a pale yellow colour

ex.en: I squeezed half a lemon over the grilled fish.
Adding lemon juice to meals can improve flavour without increasing the amount of salt consumed.

col: a slice of lemon｜một lát chanh
tip: Cả quả chanh đếm được; juice trong lemon juice không đếm được.

senses.en: A portable computer with a screen that folds over its keyboard.

ex.en: My laptop fits neatly into the front of my backpack.
Providing every student with a laptop may improve access to learning resources, but technical support remains essential.

col: laptop charger｜sạc máy tính xách tay
laptop battery｜pin máy tính xách tay
tip: laptop là máy tính xách tay; desktop thường chỉ máy tính để bàn.

senses.en: for all future time
very often, especially in an annoying way

ex.en: I wish these sunny afternoons could last forever.
Without effective conservation measures, some rare animal species could disappear forever within the next few decades.

tip: be forever doing thường biểu thị sự phàn nàn: cứ suốt ngày làm gì.

senses.en: a professional who examines and treats teeth and gums

ex.en: The dentist checked my teeth and recommended a softer toothbrush.
Regular visits to a dentist can prevent minor dental problems from developing into serious health conditions.

col: see a dentist｜đi khám nha sĩ
a dentist's appointment｜lịch hẹn với nha sĩ
a qualified dentist｜nha sĩ có chứng chỉ hành nghề
tip: dentist là nha sĩ; the dentist's có thể chỉ phòng khám nha khoa.

senses.en: to secure something so it cannot open, move, or be accessed
a device that keeps something shut until opened correctly
a small section of someone's hair

ex.en: Please lock the back door before you go upstairs.
Employees should lock their computers whenever they leave their desks to prevent unauthorised access to confidential information.

col: a lock of hair｜một lọn tóc
tip: lock là khóa lại, unlock là mở khóa; không dùng lẫn lộn.

senses.en: forming curls or curved shapes, especially when describing hair

ex.en: Her curly hair bounced as she ran upstairs.
Advertising should represent people with diverse appearances, including those with curly hair and different skin tones.

tip: curly là xoăn rõ rệt; wavy thường chỉ gợn sóng nhẹ.

senses.en: worried or uneasy about what might happen
relating to the nerves in the body

ex.en: I felt nervous before my first swimming lesson yesterday.
Students who feel nervous about examinations may benefit from regular practice and supportive feedback from teachers.

tip: nervous about theo sau là danh từ hoặc danh động từ, nghĩa là lo lắng về điều gì.

senses.en: Repeated activity done to improve a skill.
A usual or established way of doing something.
The actual use of an idea, method, or skill.

ex.en: Daily practice helped me play the guitar more confidently.
Schools should give students opportunities to put scientific knowledge into practice through experiments and practical projects.

col: put into practice｜đưa vào thực hành
tip: Tiếng Anh Anh dùng practice cho danh từ và practise cho động từ; tiếng Anh Mỹ dùng practice cho cả hai.

senses.en: the top covering of a building or vehicle
to cover a building with a roof

ex.en: Rain drummed on the roof throughout the night.
Installing solar panels on the roof can help households lower electricity bills and reduce their environmental impact.

col: under one roof｜chung một mái nhà
tip: Số nhiều là roofs; roof là mái bên ngoài, còn ceiling là trần nhà bên trong.

senses.en: having little distance from one side to the other
limited in range or achieved by only a small margin
to become or make something less wide or extensive

ex.en: The narrow path only allows us to walk single file.
Governments should invest in rural schools to narrow the educational gap between urban and remote communities.

col: a narrow street｜một con phố hẹp
a narrow victory｜chiến thắng sát nút
narrow the gap｜thu hẹp khoảng cách
narrow down the options｜thu hẹp các lựa chọn
tip: narrow down nghĩa là thu hẹp các lựa chọn, không chỉ việc con đường bị hẹp lại.
